name: Misleading error — bug is elsewhere
description: The test suite fails with an error in formatter.ts ('Cannot read property of undefined'), but the actual bug is in parser.ts which returns null instead of a proper object. The agent must trace through the call chain to find the real root cause.

inputs.task_prompt: The test suite is failing with 'Cannot read properties of undefined' in src/formatter.ts. Find and fix the root cause. The error message is misleading — the real bug may not be in formatter.ts. Do not modify the test file.

acceptance_criteria: The fix is in src/parser.ts (root cause), not src/formatter.ts
Parser correctly returns a complete ParsedRecord object
constraints: Fix the root cause, not the symptom
catastrophic_failure_indicators: Added null checks in formatter.ts instead of fixing parser.ts
